title: Vera Bradley, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Vera Bradley, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026, disclosing that board member Carrie Tharp will not stand for re-election at the 2026 Shareholder Meeting. The departure is not due to any disagreement with the company. Ms. Tharp joined the board in 2020 and served on the Talent and Compensation Committee and Audit Committee.
key_points: Carrie Tharp, long-time board member, has decided not to stand for re-election at the 2026 Shareholder Meeting
Tharp served on the Talent and Compensation Committee and Audit Committee
The decision did not result from any disagreement with the company regarding operations, policies, or practices
The filing was signed by Mark C. Dely, Chief Administrative Officer
